Canvas = the app's own Minimal band token, dark scheme (#7FC2A8, src/lib/theme.ts — rev 2026-11-06b: the critic asked for a more saturated ground than sage #46615B, still from the app's tokens), never the app's #FFFFFF ground. shots.name: 01-home-check
shots.headline: Find your home's worst room
shots.alt: Home Check result: your home's score, the room to start with, what to do first, then each room as fine, worth a look or worry.

shots.name: 02-index
shots.headline: See what to fix first
shots.alt: The Index: household items ranked worst first, each with its score and room, searchable — PFAS at home, older homes, every room.

shots.name: 03-scan
shots.headline: Scan any product at home
shots.alt: Scan: point the phone at a bottle, pan or container; the camera suggests what it is and opens its entry. Photos stay on the phone.

shots.name: 04-swaps
shots.headline: Swap one thing a week
shots.alt: Swap plan from your Home Check: one safer swap a week, worst room first, tick it off, with a weekly reminder on the phone.

shots.name: 05-studies
shots.headline: See the studies behind it
shots.alt: Bottled water (plastic): its score and evidence strength, the safer swap, the hazard, exposure and persistence scores, and the studies.

shots.name: 06-room
shots.headline: Check a whole shelf
shots.alt: Room check: every item seen in one photo, ranked by score, with the top swap first.
